_README: Registry of supported institutions. The loader reads this to resolve an institution_id to a data file. 'status' is honest labeling for the UI and for tests: 'placeholder_data' means every figure is illustrative; 'partial_verified_data' means academic/tuition figures are sourced and dated but salary figures are still placeholders (College Scorecard integration is Stage 4); 'verified' means every figure in the file has a real, dated source.
